name: r134a_condenser_water_circuit
title: R134a condenser rejecting heat into a water circuit (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise: an R134a condenser rejects 15 kW into a water circuit. The refrigerant enters as superheated vapour (saturation temperature at 350 kPa plus 80 °C) at 0.5 kg/s, the exchanger loses 1.2 kW to the ambient, and the refrigerant pressure drop is 0.1 bar. The model computes the minimum cooling-water flow for a 3 °C rise and the R134a outlet temperature. Water uses a constant specific heat.
